title: F157 the Google integration suite: the overview
caption: Four children are built in order, each on the one before; Drive, Gmail and visitors' own Google wait for a buyer to ask.

cards.title: F157 The Google integration suite
cards.text: A business connects its Google once, and its agent reads its sheets and its calendar.

cards.title: F157.1 Connect Google
cards.text: The owner signs in at Google once; the token is kept encrypted, and a pack only ever asks for a short-lived one.

cards.title: F157.2 Read a sheet
cards.text: The agent reads the rates, the menu or the stock from the sheets the business chose.

cards.title: F157.3 Free times and a booking request
cards.text: The agent finds a free time in the business's calendar and, on the visitor's yes, adds a request the owner confirms.

cards.title: F157.4 The Integrations section
cards.text: A card per integration on louis-agent.dev, and the showroom's guesthouse showing Google's at work.

cards.title: Later: Drive (F173)
cards.text: Only the files the business picked.

cards.title: Later: Gmail (F174)
cards.text: A reply drafted for the owner to send.

cards.title: Later: visitors' own Google (F175)
cards.text: After Google has verified the app.
